title: Apple's Earnings Call Reveals Supply Chain Struggles and Memory Chip Pricing
description: Apple's recent earnings call has been a trending topic in Singapore, with news outlets reporting on the impact of supply chain issues and memory chip pricing on the tech giant's sales forecasts.

sources.title: Apple Slides After Supply Shortages Hurt Sales Forecast
Apple shares tumble as AI build-out hits supply chains and growth
Tim Cook signed off on his final Apple earnings call with a warning about a ‘hundred year flood’ in memory chip pricing

sections.heading: Apple's Sales Forecasts
paragraphs: During the earnings call, Apple reported that supply shortages have negatively affected their sales forecasts, particularly in China, according to Bloomberg.

sections.heading: Impact on Share Prices
paragraphs: The news of supply chain disruptions and the build-out of AI impacting growth has led to a tumble in Apple's share prices, as reported by the Financial Times.

sections.heading: Tim Cook's Final Earnings Call
paragraphs: Fortune highlighted that this was Tim Cook's final earnings call, where he warned about a 'hundred year flood' in memory chip pricing, indicating significant challenges in the market.

faq.q: What was discussed in Apple's earnings call?
faq.a: Apple's earnings call discussed supply chain issues, their impact on sales forecasts, and the challenges in memory chip pricing, as reported by various news sources.

faq.q: How did the earnings call affect Apple's share prices?
faq.a: According to the Financial Times, the earnings call, which highlighted supply chain disruptions and growth challenges, resulted in a decline in Apple's share prices.
